thesis: Stop re-explaining the same codebase to every agent.
promise: Connect every AI agent to one memory — always current, inspectable, and under your control.

landing.tapeHint: Two agents. One project. Human still decides.
landing.how1: One source of truth for decisions, conventions, tasks, and handoffs.
landing.how2: get_brief ranks memory, drops superseded decisions, and packs the rest into a token budget — the exact markdown your agent reads.
landing.how3: Agents read and write through REST + MCP. You verify what stays.
landing.how4: Conflicts surface instead of silent contradiction.
landing.briefBody: Not a JSON dump. A ranked brief: pinned constraints first, open conflicts flagged, superseded decisions gone.
landing.briefSample:
# ContextOS brief — Atlas CLI

## Open conflicts — stop before acting
- Two agents disagree on ignore-file syntax.

## Hard constraints
- **Never commit .env** — secrets stay local.

## Decisions
- **Postgres is the only datastore** — SQLite is out of scope.

~645 / 2000 est. tokens
landing.local: MIT. Free on your machine. No account on our servers — we do not run a cloud for you.
landing.beat1: Two agents connect with cos_ keys.
landing.beat2: They write the same shared memory.
landing.beat3: Conflicts show up instead of silent contradiction.
landing.beat4: You verify and merge. The tape stays honest.
landing.quickstartDemoBody: Atlas CLI — two agents, one open conflict, seeded memory. No setup.
landing.quickstartCliBody: Install the CLI, sign in, and write MCP config in one command.
landing.quickstartDockerBody: Production path on your machine. Demo data seeds on first boot.

value.kicker: Why a compiler, not a dump
value.title: Ship less context. Keep more truth.
value.lead: Dumping every memory entry into the prompt burns tokens and hides what matters. ContextOS ranks, drops superseded decisions, and packs the rest into a 2k budget.
value.summary: ~{{saved}} tokens saved (~{{pct}}%). Brief includes {{included}} entries, omits {{omitted}} for the {{budget}} token budget.

brief.lead: ContextOS ranks the shared brain, drops decisions that were superseded, and packs the rest into a token budget. This is the exact text an agent receives.

brief.omittedHint: Raise the budget or search memory directly to reach these.
